blurb: Guests can sample a variety of fruit, rose, white, and red wines made from estate-grown grapes, as well as craft beers including light beer, red ale, pilsner, IPA, stout, and porter. The tasting house is located in a remodeled old farmhouse with a rustic look and is handicap accessible. Food options include paninis, meat and cheese plates, bruschetta, pizza, pretzel bites, and snacks.
